classification: EXPLORATORY; retrospective proxy data; unqualified for CME futures conclusions
hypothesis: Prior 50 completed 30-minute highs/lows trigger stop entries whose one-bar hold has positive net expectancy after stated placeholder costs.
falsifier: No positive net expectancy in cost-aware NQ.F and ES.F results, or results fail the 1m trigger, $1,000 stop, next-30m-open exit, or two-entry-per-session-day rules.

rules.entry_orders: one buy stop at rolling prior high and one sell stop at rolling prior low; OCO after first fill
rules.exit: opening print of immediately following 30-minute bar
rules.entry_resolution: native Engine STOP order checked against each 1m candle; stop-price fill, gap-through fills at 1m open
rules.ambiguous_1m_entry_stop: retain and report; OHLC cannot establish sequence

instruments.NQ.F: LSE proxy for NQ; not verified as a specific dated CME contract
instruments.ES.F: LSE proxy for ES; not verified as a specific dated CME contract

evaluation.warmup: source bars before 2026-01-01 used only to form 50 completed-bar rolling extrema

cost_assumptions.cost_aware: $2.50 per contract per fill plus one tick adverse slippage per fill; exploratory placeholder, not brokerage-certified
